'''Vanguard Outpost''' was a military outpost of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] that was situated on the [[Markaran Plains]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]], along the southern ridge of the [[Jacent Valley]].
